candidates.colors: pomelo gold #F3CD58 for the fruit and its two stubby hands; dark burnt brown #603A27 for the handwritten V, two eyes and one single broad blunt leaf; background terracotta #C66B45
candidates.subject: one chubby round pomelo fruit character affectionately hanging over the upper-left arm of one large handwritten capital "V". Both tiny rounded hands drape over the thick stroke, its plump body cuddles against that arm. One broad rounded leaf suggests pomelo. The V is dominant and the fruit nestles into it, together one compact connected silhouette.
candidates.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 × 1536.
Background: fill the entire square with solid #C66B45 muted warm terracotta. Keep this color visible in every open area and the corners unoccupied by the character.
Subject: one chubby round pomelo fruit character affectionately hanging over the upper-left arm of one large handwritten capital "V". Both tiny rounded hands drape over the thick stroke, its plump body cuddles against that arm. One broad rounded leaf suggests pomelo. The V is dominant and the fruit nestles into it, together one compact connected silhouette.
Personality: extremely simplified, cute, smart, relaxed and playfully endearing. A lovable anytime-anywhere creative companion.
Complexity: use only 4–7 large basic shapes in one compact integrated silhouette, at most two broad internal color regions, two simple eyes and optionally one tiny mouth. Remove all nonessential outlines, anatomy, textures, decoration. Readable at 32 × 32.
Color behavior: exactly three semantic colors in the complete image, pomelo gold #F3CD58 for the fruit and its two stubby hands; dark burnt brown #603A27 for the handwritten V, two eyes and one single broad blunt leaf; background terracotta #C66B45. Reuse the two subject colors for facial marks and V. Broad purposeful color masses with clear separation. No additional colors.
Composition: upright integrated character and V emerging from lower-left, occupying 85–95% of the square. Crop bottom or assigned side only when helpful, keep both little hands visible. Do not center the composition. Keep the capital V immediately readable, upright, thick, rounded, casually handwritten, with a rounded bottom turn and blunt stroke ends, not a checkmark.
Style: ultra-clean graphic treatment, soft broad shapes, compact baby proportions, gentle cheeks, thick rounded contours. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Finish: only the single character interacting with the V on a full-canvas uniform background, normal square outer corners.
Constraints: The only lettering permitted is exactly one handwritten uppercase "V", integral to the composition. No other text or watermark. No borders, frames, cards, presentation masks, extra characters, scenery, fragile lines, sharp tips, detailed anatomy, unnecessary outlines, decorative marks, photorealistic materials, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspots, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong 3D rendering, external cast shadows. No background texture, vignette or lighting variation.
